overall: GOOD today once the dawn showers clear
limiterDetail: Right now it is 🟡 MARGINAL, mainly on rain that has already fallen (the rating uses the last 3 hours). Looking ahead, the main limiter is current at Tara and Turda, then wind: Barangonan is at 10–11 kt until about 10 AM, and Tara, Turda and Decabobo gust up to 9–12 kt around 1–3 PM. Everywhere else the current stays at 0.6 kt or less and 24h rain is 0–3.3 mm.

pagasa.detail: PAGASA: no gale, tropical cyclone wind signal or heavy-rain warning for Calamian / MIMAROPA. The latest MIMAROPA item is General Flood Advisory #4 (Final), Region 4-B , Tue 20 Oct 5:24 AM PHT, which closes the advisory series (#3 was issued Mon 5:43 PM).

changed.title: ⚠️ What changed since yesterday afternoon
items: Pre-dawn showers pulled the dawn snapshot down to 6 GOOD and 10 MARGINAL (yesterday 2 PM it was 14 GOOD, 2 POOR). The showers were 0.5–1.7 mm/h from about 3 to 5 AM over the Linapacan side, and ECMWF shows them over by 6 AM. The next 24 hours are mostly dry, and Tue 20 still rates GOOD for the day. Tara and Turda improve from POOR to MARGINAL this morning (current 0.7–0.8 kt) but climb back to 1.2–1.3 kt from about 1 PM.

The supply timing is unchanged: ABOVE NORMAL today, softening Wednesday, BELOW NORMAL Thu 22. But Thu 22 and Fri 23 are windier now (12 kt, gusts 18, up from about 10 kt), and the shortage window now runs Wed 21 to Mon 26 (was to Sun 25).
PAGASA has closed out the MIMAROPA flood advisory: General Flood Advisory #4 (Final) came out at 5:24 AM PHT today. There is no gale or storm signal.

shortageRisk: Surge flag OFF (unchanged). Shortage risk stays ELEVATED , now for the Wed 21 to Mon 26 catch, felt Thu 22 to Tue 27. Tara and Turda run BELOW NORMAL locally on current. Today is the last ABOVE NORMAL day, so buying ahead today still makes sense.

bestWindow.headline: This morning, about 6–11 AM
details: 6–11 AM: Coron, Culion, Galoc, Maglalambay and Panlaitan are the calmest, with 1.7–3.5 kt wind and 0.0–0.2 kt current; Culion, Galoc and Maglalambay are slack. The model's calmest combined hour is about 6 AM at Maglalambay. Tara and Turda are easiest from 7 to 11 AM (0.7–4 kt wind, 0.6–0.8 kt current).

Noon to 3 PM: Nangalao and Cabunlawan go nearly calm (0.6–2.6 kt) on 0.1–0.3 kt current, Barangonan eases to 2.3–3.7 kt, and Linapacan sits at 3–5 kt on 0.2 kt current. Ciron stays at 0.6–2.6 kt until about 6 PM.

Keep boats off Barangonan until about 10 AM (10–11 kt), off Tara and Turda after 1 PM (1.0–1.3 kt current), and watch the 9–12 kt pickup around Tara, Turda and Decabobo from 1 to 3 PM. Winds rise again to 8–9.5 kt across most grounds after Wed 1 AM.
